description: MainActivity.java for an Android app, serving as the launcher activity that manages UI fragments, menu options, and logging setup.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that initializes UI, manages menu options, and sets up logging for the app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and adds the CardReaderFragment if no saved state exists.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu from XML.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares the menu, toggling visibility and title of the log toggle item based on current state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, toggling log display.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up logging chain with LogWrapper, MessageOnlyLogFilter, and LogFragment.
